name: ExportToPDF
label: Export Worksheet to PDF (HTTP)
description: Exports an Excel worksheet to PDF.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The relative path to the Excel workbook in the OneDrive or SharePoint drive (e.g., 'Reports/Summary.xlsx').

fields.name: WorksheetName
fields.label: Worksheet Name
fields.description: The name of the worksheet to export to PDF (e.g., 'Dashboard'). If omitted or invalid, the entire workbook may be exported depending on implementation.

fields.name: PDFBytes
fields.label: PDF Bytes
fields.description: The exported PDF document as a byte array. Can be saved to a file or used in downstream processes such as email attachments.
